-- Question 1: In transit for SKU AH-KTL-0001-BLK
SELECT 
  sh.v as booking_no,
  st.v as status,
  eta.v as eta,
  SUM(sl.v) as units
FROM "shipment/status" st
JOIN "shipment/booking_no" sh ON sh.e = st.e
JOIN "shipment/eta" eta ON eta.e = st.e
JOIN "core/part_of" sl ON sl.e = (
  SELECT e FROM "shipment_line/quantity" WHERE e IN (
    SELECT e FROM "core/part_of" WHERE v = st.e
  )
)
JOIN "shipment_line/po_line" pl ON pl.e = sl.e
JOIN "po_line/sku" ps ON ps.e = pl.v
JOIN "sku/code" sk ON sk.e = ps.v AND sk.v = 'AH-KTL-0001-BLK'
WHERE st.v IN ('departed', 'arrived')
GROUP BY sh.e, sh.v, st.v, eta.v

-- Question 2: Supplier NBBW's POs with later current ETD than first recorded
WITH po_etd_history AS (
  SELECT 
    po.e,
    pn.v as po_number,
    h.v as etd_value,
    h.tx,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY po.e ORDER BY h.tx ASC) as rn
  FROM history."po/etd" h
  JOIN "po/number" pn ON pn.e = h.e
  JOIN "po/supplier" ps ON ps.e = h.e
  JOIN "supplier/code" sc ON sc.e = ps.v AND sc.v = 'NBBW'
  WHERE h.op = 'assert'
)
SELECT 
  po_number,
  etd_value as first_etd,
  (SELECT v FROM "po/etd" WHERE e = po_etd_history.e) as current_etd
FROM po_etd_history
WHERE rn = 1
  AND etd_value < (SELECT v FROM "po/etd" WHERE e = po_etd_history.e)
ORDER BY po_number

-- Question 8: Shopify customer 8995877069469 and duplicate accounts
WITH RECURSIVE customer_chain AS (
  -- Start with the given customer
  SELECT e, e as root
  FROM "shopify/customer_id" 
  WHERE v = '8995877069469'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Follow same_as links forward
  SELECT same_as.v, cc.root
  FROM "core/same_as" same_as
  JOIN customer_chain cc ON same_as.e = cc.e
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Follow same_as links backward
  SELECT same_as.e, cc.root
  FROM "core/same_as" same_as
  JOIN customer_chain cc ON same_as.v = cc.e
),
all_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e FROM customer_chain
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT ac.e) as accounts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_cust.e) as orders
FROM all_customers ac
LEFT JOIN "order/customer" order_cust ON order_cust.v = ac.e
